subject: How do you see historic logging for your shinyapps.io app?

messages.author: 1667ac6354bdba89
messages.subject: How do you see historic logging for your shinyapps.io app?
parts:
Hi,

I have a bug in a deployed shinyapp that only seems to happen to some users, so I added a bit of logging to try and track it down - but the log files on shinyapps.io and via shinyapps::showLogs() only show the latest instance. I see I have had 20 connections, but only the last session is in the app logging file.

I added logging via warning() - perhaps I should do it some other way?

Is there a way to see the logs for all historic instances of your app?

Yours sincerely,
Mark

messages.author: 3da48b33a2f506a9
messages.subject: Re: How do you see historic logging for your shinyapps.io app?
parts:
Mark,

You could try listing more log entries, by specifying n line numbers as follows:

showLogs(entries=n)


Let us know if this doesn't help.

Fereshteh
